research_rationale:
EO 12891 (signed 1994-01-15; 59 FR 2935-2937, Federal Register of January 20, 1994) was read in the held Federal Register text jobs/fr-originals/data/full_run/texts/EO_12891.txt (PDF pages 21-23 of the capture; the following pages belong to neighbouring documents). Identity, page and date confirmed from the printed heading, page numbers and signature date. The order establishes the Advisory Committee on Human Radiation Experiments (section 1), defines human radiation experiments in two categories and directs advice on specific experiments and the review period (section 2(a)), sets the Committee's evaluation functions (section 2(b)), provides information, compensation and funding (section 3), and assigns the President's Federal Advisory Committee Act functions to the Human Radiation Interagency Working Group, terminates the Committee 30 days after its final report and disclaims enforceable rights (section 4). The 18 clauses in the inventory were compared with the printed order from its heading through its signature: they cover every subsection and item; the enacting clause is not a command. The dossier evidence for EO 13062 was re-read against its held text: section 3(a) revokes EO 12891 by number and subject, and section 7 gives the express effective date 1997-09-30. Section 4(b) provides that the Committee terminates 30 days after submitting its final report to the Human Radiation Interagency Working Group. If that report was the final report submitted on or before 1995-10-03, the Committee terminated no later than 1995-11-02 and the order was functionally spent by then. Under the owner ruling of 2026-10-21 on report deadlines, which reaches report-relative sunsets, this is a spent fact and not the end; it is not recorded as a dated later event because no exact date is held.
